name: manual_3daf5f
claim: When a sweep finds stale references: update the live code, config and docs, classify dated records as historical in a ledger instead of rewriting them, keep load-bearing legacy identifiers, and respect repo gates (markdown lint on whole files, the TDD gate for web source, the whole-file-deletion guard) through their documented, justified overrides only; publishing stays on hold until the operator says otherwise, and each task gets its own worktree and branch.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-12: fourteen dated records carried old lint debt that blocked any commit touching them, and reflowing history is noise, so a ledger replaced banners; the web UI mock labels needed an adjacent test so they were left for their own change; a justified override recorded the operator-approved template rename; everything was committed locally on separate worktrees and branches, and the one push happened only after the operator ran it.

rationale: 2026-11-12: fourteen dated records carried old lint debt that blocked any commit touching them, and reflowing history is noise, so a ledger replaced banners; the web UI mock labels needed an adjacent test so they were left for their own change; a justified override recorded the operator-approved template rename; everything was committed locally on separate worktrees and branches, and the one push happened only after the operator ran it.
